defects.label: blocker
defects.summary: Review stage tool policy forbids artifact_write but reviewers must emit review_findings.json per architecture and requirements

payload.reroute_reason: Critical blocker CS1 requires tool_policy correction to allow reviewers to emit findings artifacts. CS2 (Intake canonical artifact writes) also requires tool_policy fix. Both are governance/tool_policy defects requiring reroute to risk_gov_canonical_v1 for repair. Additionally, validator_report shows 12 deliverable ID violations and multiple missing risk/decision references that require ID minting outside triage authority, plus evidence pointer schema mismatches (CS3) requiring requirements clarification. The combination of critical tool_policy blockers plus structural ID/schema issues exceeds safe patch scope.
